items.source_name: NHC Hurricane Simon Advisory 25 (8:00 AM MST Tue Oct 13)
items.summary: NHC Advisory 25 (8:00 AM MST Tue Oct 13 / 1500 UTC): Simon holds at Cat 1, 90 mph, 977 mb, ~105 mi W of Cabo Corrientes, moving W at 2 mph; forecast to drift slowly 1-2 days then turn north by late week, remaining a hurricane through midweek. CHANGE: Mexico downgraded the Hurricane Warning for Las Islas Marias to a Hurricane Watch. In effect: Hurricane Watch for north of Escuinapa to Bahia Tempehuaya AND Las Islas Marias; Tropical Storm Watch for Cabo Corrientes to Escuinapa. Hurricane conditions possible on Las Islas Marias Wednesday and mainland Thursday; TS conditions possible by Wednesday. Rainfall: 1-2 in, isolated 3 in over Baja California Sur, Nayarit, Sinaloa by Friday.
items.title: Simon Advisory 25: Hurricane Warning downgraded to Hurricane Watch for Las Islas Marias
